full_translation_en:
Federal Parliament
House of Representatives, 2082
Second Session
Meeting Number - 57
Daily Agenda
Federal Parliament of Nepal
2083 Ashoj 5, Monday
1:00 PM
1. Letter from the Office of the President
The Honorable Speaker will read out the letter received from the Office of the President regarding the certification of a bill.
2. Formation of a Special Committee
The Honorable Speaker will present a proposal for the formation of a Parliamentary Special Committee on Climate Change in the Himalayas and Bhote-Koshi-Trishuli Disasters, in accordance with Rule 180 of the House of Representatives Regulations, 2082, along with the names of the honorable members to be included in the committee.
3. Management Work
The Honorable Minister for Women, Children, Senior Citizens and Social Security, Sita WADI, will present a proposal stating, "Let the 'Child Related (First Amendment) Bill, 2082' be sent to the relevant committee for clause-by-clause discussion."
On behalf of the Right Honorable Prime Minister and Minister of Defense, Balen Shah, the Honorable Minister for Law, Justice and Parliamentary Affairs, Sobita GAUTAM, will:
(a) Present a proposal stating, "Let's discuss the National Service Corps Bill, 2082, along with the report of the State Affairs and Good Governance Committee."
(b) Present a proposal stating, "Let the National Service Corps Bill, 2082, be passed."
Padma Prasad Pandey
General Secretary

sections.name: Opening
sections.summary_en: The Speaker will read a letter from the Office of the President regarding bill certification. Following this, a proposal to form a Special Committee on Climate Change and Disasters in the Himalayas will be presented.

sections.name: Main Business
sections.summary_en: The Minister for Women, Children, Senior Citizens and Social Security proposed sending the Child Related (First Amendment) Bill, 2082 to committee. The Minister for Law, Justice and Parliamentary Affairs proposed discussing and passing the National Service Corps Bill, 2082.
